comparison.objective: Measure bars and sort them by tolerance; candidate physically separates mixed media and washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Caliper operation, reading-based classification, and pick-and-place versus geometry-driven screening and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: All bars in correct GO/NO-GO trays versus media passing apertures while every washer remains retained.
comparison.reason: Both separate categories, but one tests metrology-guided sorting and the other tests physical screening mechanics.
